measurements: variantProfile is nested synchronous main-thread wrapper wall time with observer overhead, not GPU time or proof of shader compilation; pool counters track successful entity growth/reuse, cache misses/hits use constant-time before/after Map size (one insertion or no change in the pinned synchronous method); unexpected shrink or growth greater than one throws a diagnostic error rather than reporting a hit; high-water is observed map size; sceneUpdateMs times forwarded filtered scene input, manualTickMs measures RAF ticks; variantCohorts partitions eligible native RAF frames with observed aftermath into cacheMiss (one or more new returned variants) and aftermathNoNewVariant (visible aftermath, no newly returned variant), excluding pointer renders and frames without observed aftermath; each cohort counts frames and aggregates same-frame full app-frame, scene-update, manualTick and renderer-call times without per-frame export; off frames have empty native cohorts while off scene/tick remain in variantProfile; conditional association is not a causal cache or GPU claim; nested timings overlap and must not be subtracted; main-thread wall time, not GPU time; rendererCallMs times only renderer facade invocation, totalPresentationMs includes projection and pose resolution, displayFrameTotalMs times the entire eligible runDisplayFrame invocation (gameplay, clock/input/pose, projection, rendering, sync and UI), not exact gameplay.advance CPU; do not subtract nested wall times to infer scoring CPU; scored-hit deltas compare gameplay snapshots at app-frame entry/exit; pointerTotalMs measures the outer pointer-triggered presentation; wallElapsedMs includes menu/setup and MUST NOT be used for FPS; eligibleActiveMs sums only consecutive eligible display intervals, eligibleIntervalCount and ineligibleFrameCount expose coverage; 1-ms approximate p50/p95 histogram over every sample in each window; count and exact max cover the entire window; aftermath observed totals sum entries/pieces across render calls, not distinct frames; postHitBurst summarizes scored-hit display frames and eligible display frames starting within 1200 ms after each scored hit, but excludes the first scored frame's preceding interval from burst intervals (it remains in before-first-hit); retains aggregate histograms but no per-note records; display intervals are browser presentation cadence, not GPU time
coverage: valid windows require playing Test, Automatic Feedback OFF, visible selected hand, CV confirmed idle and stable reported backing/viewport/DPR; invalidReasons mark violations; compare hit counts/section manually; each window carries its own mode and session generation
